title: JDORFX author's announcement vs independent proof
summary: Rony G. Flatscher reports Alireza Ismaili's JDORFX extension of Philipp Schaller's 2024 work. The announced comparison of 100 canonical JDOR commands is 92 no known limitation, 3 JavaFX platform limitations, 5 partial, zero missing; JDORFX contains 140 commands, including six 3D controls and eighteen animation commands. This is not independently verified by Alchemy.
invariants: Retrieve and checksum the newly announced archive and thesis before claiming source coverage.
Test true 2D/3D drawing, clipping, printing, clipboard, compositing, animation, JavaFX thread and window lifecycle.
A BSF runtime pass does not prove visual parity or graphics command correctness.

provenance.source: Rony G. Flatscher release announcement provided in conversation, October 2026
